summary_en: The video features a male chef and a female host demonstrating how to make pan-fried crêpes in a kitchen studio. It begins with an introduction of ingredients, mixing batter with milk and scallions, searing bacon, and then pouring the batter, arranging sausages into a square shape, and adding an egg in the center. Finally, the crêpe is folded, sliced, and presented alongside a salad for tasting.
